building.title: The Clock Tower East Wing, University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 119's outline from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; used only to choose the crop box, to pick the building's own points (frame.near_outline) and to draw on the heightmap figure; the frame comes from the LiDAR.
building.outline_note: building 119's outline from campus.json without its north-west tail (four points: the low link to the Clock Tower, under trees), so that the Clock Tower's own points and the trees over the link do not count as this building's; the model still draws the link.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

door.note: view frame: the foot of the stair tower's face toward the car park, where the LiDAR ground is 40.0 m (-0.06 to +0.08 within a metre of it), so ground is 40.0 and the model's y is 0 there. The photographs show no doorway in that face: this point only sets where the model meets the map's ground; place.py puts it on the map

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) within near_outline m of building 119's outline without its north-west tail (building.outline_note): centre = mean x/y of points higher than tower_above m (the ridges of the range and the tops of the towers); axis = the bearing of most of the walls seen from above (axis_from walls: -45.44 deg; the principal axis of the points between min_above and spine_below m within spine_radius m, -44.18 deg, is 1.3 deg from it), pointing north-west as street_side is west; toStreet = the axis turned 90 deg toward street_side: south-west, to the lawn and the car park.

streetview.pano_ids_note: the four Google panoramas within 80 m on the lawn side (2025-05, 28 to 62 m away, a walk across the campus). Left out: three Google panoramas on Princes Street (2024-07, 80 to 97 m, behind the Clock Tower South Wing) and two user-contributed ones (not Google's; the loop uses Google's own only).
